summary: NMP Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 1 to its September 4, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with GTS Holdings, LLC and Pubco for target Gibson Technical Services. The amendment extends the Company and Pubco audited financials delivery deadline to October 9, 2026, with NMP retaining sole discretion to extend further via written notice. The Registration Statement is due within five business days after the audit delivery date. No price, premium, or board recommendation was disclosed. Key watch item: deal timing and termination-risk exposure from any further audit delays.
